entries.9de3ea30920a1e9f: A single-segment supermarket business operating stores in Hokkaido. As of February 28, 2026, it operated 33 stores: 21 in Sapporo and surrounding areas, 7 in the Dōtō area, 1 in the Dōhoku area, 2 in the Dōnan area, and 2 in the Shiribeshi area. It has no consolidated subsidiaries and conducts business through the filing company alone, with 383 employees. The Lucky Fresh and Deli Center, which processes and supplies meat, fresh fish and prepared foods, and the cold storage center, which delivers fruit, vegetables and marine products, support the stores.

entries.d2e93246cf40639a: Food products, mainly fresh food products. It handles fresh food products such as vegetables, fruit, fresh fish and meat, and general food products such as processed foods. In sales by product for the fiscal year ended February 2026, food products were 101.1% of the prior year.
